notes: M=1, 4, 256, and 1024 cases are covered across GEMM and full MLP baselines.
The rotating-weight case uses 38 buffers and records synchronized host-call latency.
The SmolLM stateful cache record covers prefill length 4 and one decode step to length 5.
The pinned CUTLASS persistent body retains its TMA/WGMMA pipeline across assigned tiles.
Changed tensor addresses, contents, and M=4 to M=256 to M=1024 tile counts pass against the original launch and restarting adapter.

task_03.evidence: mixed_body.json, mixed_shape_m1.json, mixed_shape_m256.json, mixed_kernel_trace.json, generated_typed_bodies.py, mixed_m4_memcheck.log, mixed_m4_racecheck.log, mixed_m4_synccheck.log, mixed_shape_m1_memcheck.log, mixed_shape_m256_memcheck.log
passed: One M=4 cooperative kernel contains two range GEMMs, typed BF16/FP32 vector and reduction work, four cross-CTA barriers, and two workers that skip GEMM tiles but still join barriers.
A leader-scanned release/acquire barrier passes repeated calls at 4, 24, and 60 workers; idle GEMM workers still join every barrier.
The complete compiled kernel uses 256 threads, 232 registers per thread, 230400 shared bytes, and one active block per SM. On 60 SMs this admits 60 workers; 61 is rejected before the workload launch.
Three changed M=4 bindings pass at 60 workers with delayed producers and a one-kernel profiler trace. Three M=4-to-M=1 and three M=4-to-M=256 shape/tile-count rebinds also pass at 60 workers.
Final-source memcheck and synccheck report zero errors and racecheck reports zero hazards at 60 workers. M=1 and M=256 shape-rebind memcheck reports are also clean.
The vector and reduction bodies are generated from typed scalar expressions and record their source hashes.
The largest compiled-resource-admitted 60-worker grid passes; an oversized 61-worker request is rejected before launch.
limitations: CUDA Graph replay is outside the G0 probe; the tested eager calls pass their epoch values from the host.
